items.caption: A seal-style rendering of 請, the traditional form whose Shuowen analysis identifies 言 as the semantic element and 青 as the sound element.
items.alt: Black seal-style rendering of 請, with 言 on the left and 青 on the right.
items.selection_reason: This readable seal-style rendering gives a visual reference for the traditional graph discussed in the historical analysis. It is a modern vector redraw, not an ancient artifact.

limitations.text: No dated ancient specimen sequence for 請 is established here. The selected image is a modern redraw in seal style, so it cannot show when the graph or its components first appeared.
